question:
Let \(f:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R\) be a differentiable and strictly decreasing function such that \(f(0)=1\) and \(f(1)=0\). For \(x\in\mathbb R\), let
\[
F(x)=\int_0^x (t-2)f(t)\,dt.
\]
Then

options.B: \(F\) has a unique minimum in \((0,3)\) but has no maximum in \((0,3)\)
options.C: \(F\) has a unique maximum in \((0,3)\) but has no minimum in \((0,3)\)
options.D: \(F\) has a unique maximum and a unique minimum in \((0,3)\).
